mechanism: Azithromycin may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of isocarboxazid, increasing MAOI levels and risk of hypertensive crisis; additionally, azithromycin has weak serotonergic properties that could potentiate serotonin syndrome when combined with MAOI.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective azithromycin dose and monitor closely for hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome symptoms, and QTc prolongation.
